# Bella Betting

> Bella Betting (bellabetting.com.au) is an Australian website publishing a short daily tips card for Australian horse racing and some pre-match sport. General opinion only; 18+ only. Bella Betting is not a bookmaker, does not take bets, and has no bookmaker affiliate or commission arrangements.

- Daily tips card published each race day at 9:09am AEDT (Sydney time) to free members.
- Tips line for free members (18+): 0495 040 400.
- Every published selection is recorded on the results page, wins and losses. Past results do not predict future results.
- Free membership trial until 10 December 2026, never auto-converted to paid.
- No guarantee of any result. Betting is not a way to make money.

Responsible gambling: Chances are you're about to lose. Gambling Help 1800 858 858, https://www.gamblinghelponline.org.au. Self-exclude via BetStop: https://www.betstop.gov.au.
